headline: Tatum explodes for forty one as Celtics finally snap losing streak
morning_brew: Finally, a little bit of breathing room for the C's. After dropping four straight, Jayson Tatum took the wheel on Tuesday night and carried us to a 131-116 win over the Wizards, scoring twenty eight of his forty one points in the first half alone. It wasn't the prettiest basketball, but when you are trying to kill a four-game skid, you don't ask how, you just take the W and pray the losing bug stays dead. Neemias Queta was an absolute monster inside, giving us the kind of interior presence I've been screaming for, and seeing the team get back in the win column feels like a massive weight off my chest. I haven't felt this relieved since cousin Jimmy finally stopped talking about his fantasy football lineup last month.

The Pats are still the main event in town this week, and the chatter around the facility ahead of this Sunday's tilt with the Chargers is getting louder than the T at rush hour. We are sitting at five and five and every single snap feels like it has the weight of the season behind it, regardless of what the talking heads on TV are barking about. I am still trying to wrap my head around our offensive consistency, or lack thereof, but Mike Vrabel needs to find a way to get this team to play a full sixty minutes if we want to stay in the hunt for a wild card spot. My neighbor Rick is already deep into his third conspiracy theory about the play-calling, so let's hope the coaching staff has it figured out before Sunday.

It is a busy Wednesday in the Hub because the Bruins are back at TD Garden tonight to host the Winnipeg Jets, and they are going to need every bit of that home ice advantage to stay upright. I am hoping for a clean game from the jump, because we can't afford to get off to a slow start against a squad like Winnipeg. After that, we have the Maple Leafs rolling into town on Friday for a classic matchup that always brings the heat and a headache. No baseball talk today, just pure hardwood and ice as we try to keep this momentum rolling right through the weekend.

news_digest.dans_take: It was about damn time the boys put together a full night of basketball.

trend_watch.trend: Poured in forty one points on thirteen of twenty five shooting while adding eight assists in Tuesday's win.
trend_watch.dans_take: That is the superstar level we need every single night if we want to make noise in the East.

trend_watch.trend: Knocked down six of nine three-pointers and finished with twenty eight points in his thirty three minutes of action.
trend_watch.dans_take: When he is feeling it from deep like that, this offense is basically impossible to defend.

trend_watch.trend: Dominated the paint with twenty one points on nine of eleven shooting and grabbed five boards.
trend_watch.dans_take: Queta played with such a chip on his shoulder, and frankly, he looked like the only guy who woke up ready to hit someone.
